Can a simple seated leg exercise really help lower blood sugar? Learn how moving your legs while sitting may support blood sugar control, especially after meals, and how to add this easy movement to your daily routine.
Brad Heineck, the late Bob Schrupp, and their team created the most famous physical therapy channel, helping millions stay healthy, fit, and pain-free. Bob’s mission lives on through his children and the Bob & Brad team.
